name: Sparse spatial data structures for NeRF
definition: Methods that use sparse data structures (sparse grids, octrees, VDBs) to localize the surface interface and concentrate samples only in relevant regions, effectively skipping empty space to reduce MLP evaluations.
summary: Sparse spatial data structures for NeRF use octrees or VDBs to skip empty space, reducing MLP evaluations and speeding up rendering by up to ten times compared to standard NeRF.
